item.dc:creator: Zhen Lei Bei Liu Penggen Cheng Yunju Nie a School of Surveying and Geoinformation Engineering, East China University of Technology, Nanchang, Chinab Jiangxi Key Laboratory of Watershed Ecological Process and Information, East China University of Technology, Nanchang, ChinaZhen Lei received the Master’s degree in Geomatics Engineering from East China University of Technology, Nanchang, China, in 2024.
